ext_description.message: Scans PSA, CGC and BGS slab photos on a page and opens the official cert page. Reads on-device. Not affiliated with any grader.
ext_description.description: Web Store / chrome://extensions description, max 132 characters.

action_title.message: Scan this page for slab cert numbers

about_privacy.message: Images are processed on this device and never uploaded. The cert number goes to the grader when its page opens, and to PSA if you added a PSA key. The card name and grade go to PriceCharting for the value, or for Pokémon cards to PokemonPriceTracker if you added its key. eBay only gets what you search for when you open an eBay link.

about_lookup.message: A cert lookup shows what the grader's database says about a number. It can't tell whether the slab in a photo is genuine.

about_disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with PSA, CGC or Beckett.

about_trademarks.message: PSA, CGC and Beckett are trademarks of their respective owners.

about_uninstall.message: Removing the extension deletes its scan history.

privacy_link.description: Link target is a release dependency.

setting_ppt_key_hint.message: For Pokémon slabs: the value comes from recent eBay sales in the slab's grade (PSA, BGS, CGC) through PokemonPriceTracker's official API, with no PriceCharting page in between. The free key has 100 credits a day; one card costs up to 4 (a grade change costs nothing). Only the card name and number are sent; the key stays on this device. Without a key, or when a card isn't found, PriceCharting is used.
